about_the_game:
Turn a small apartment high above the city into a garden. Start with a few pots and whatever space you can find, then learn what your plants need as you care for them from seed to harvest. Cook with what you grow, sell what you make, discover new varieties, and reinvest your earnings into an ever-expanding indoor garden.

You'll expand by unlocking new rooms, increasing the space available to you. Over time, you'll see your collection of plants grow throughout your apartment and eventually, even onto the rooftop. Along the way, you'll be able to decorate your home to create a space that feels truly your own.

Flowers, berries, and vegetables each have their own needs. Find the right planter (container), give them the perfect soil mix using compost, sand, clay, and more, then place them where the light and temperature suit them best. Of course, you'll need to make sure to keep them watered and free of weeds as they grow!

Your harvest doesn't have to stay in the pot. Take what you've harvested into the kitchen and turn it into salads, baked treats, and a wide variety of other dishes. The people who live in the apartment will pay you good money for your homemade meals!

What begins with a few plants can gradually take over your home. You'll unlock new rooms, make use of the balconies and other growing spaces, and eventually take your garden all the way to the rooftop greenhouse.

Your plants are not the only things that make up your apartment, after all, you have to live there. Mix and match furniture and decorations, arrange the plants as part of the room itself, and decide what kind of home you want to create. Don't forget your meow-tasic friend while you work on the apartment. Your cat will need to feel at home as well!
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB / AMD Radeon RX 570 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: For comfortable experience it is highly recommended to use SSD
